name: Chris Larsen

lean.basis: Mostly a Democratic donor (Kamala Harris in 2024, Josh Shapiro, House Majority PAC, and Gavin Newsom for 2028) with a centrist, business-friendly bent: he spent millions against California's proposed billionaire tax, backed moderate San Francisco candidates, and gave to both a Democrat and a Republican in the California governor's race. His firm Ripple funds the bipartisan crypto super PAC Fairshake.

current_role: Co-founder and executive chairman of Ripple
summary: Chris Larsen co-founded the online lender Prosper and, in 2012 with Jed McCaleb, the crypto firm that became Ripple, which he led as CEO before becoming executive chairman. The SEC sued Ripple and him in 2020 and dropped its remaining claims against him in 2023. With his partner Lyna Lam he is a leading Democratic-leaning donor, while Ripple is one of the biggest funders of the crypto super PAC Fairshake.
